response.sql: WITH station_avg AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bw FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bw) AS base FROM station_avg), above AS (SELECT s.avg_bw, b.base FROM station_avg s CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE s.avg_bw > b.base) SELECT AVG(avg_bw) AS mean_above_avg, AVG(avg_bw - base) AS mean_excess_over_baseline FROM above;

assumptions.assumption: Missing values are NULLs in telescopes.bandusagepct and are excluded before averaging, so each station's average is over its non-null telescopes only. Stations with no non-null values have no average and are left out of the baseline.
'Above the baseline' means strictly greater than the baseline (a station exactly equal to it is excluded).
The baseline is the unweighted mean of the per-station averages, so each station counts once regardless of how many telescopes it has.
